name: prism-faas
description: Prism FaaS is a serverless function orchestrator: versioned function registry, MicroVM placement with best-fit bin packing and LRU eviction, warm pools with keep-alive, cold start vs snapshot-restore modelling, predictive pre-warming, tenant token-bucket and concurrency quotas, 429 throttling, GB-second billing and isolated handler execution.
author: Soumya Bhandare (krishyaa06)
